Needs changes before merge: one blocking item.

The warning uses the mounted machine and the tool's posted RPM. The tool keeps its speed. The command history stays intact. The spindle comparisons and the post refusal stay the same.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3729` — Class: missing UI review evidence. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the catalog add with the same tool and mounted machine, so the changed status text is visible. The body currently says “No screenshot”. The review instructions require screenshots for a UI change, including a status-text change. Apply this evidence rule to the whole UI change. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body. Do not commit images or review evidence to the PR branch.

**Local build and tests**

I read the whole diff and checked the laws from upstream/main's AGENTS.md. The local trial merge is `330c79f634c243085e532cd3dbf883dde97e5890`, with base `d3c2bf0bae31f99809984032b2f778afeddf4d8a`. Its first parent is the PR head above. The merge has no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 392 steps: 390 passed, 2 failed, 0 stalled; 38.3 minutes |
| Post, app and UI test builds | Passed |
| `camcraft-post` `machine_check` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `mcp` | 54 passed, including all four new warning tests |
| `camcraft-app` `default_machine_limits` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `mcp_doc_drift` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-ui` `machine` | 7 passed, including the new status test |
| `camcraft-app` `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps passed; all 11 light tests passed; 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The two red quick steps are `ui suites: lib` and `ui suites: shell`. I ran both full steps on bare upstream/main, `d94b9816d`, with:

`cargo xtask gate batch --only 'ui suites: lib' --only 'ui suites: shell'`

Both fail there in the same tests. The failing test sources are unchanged from the trial-merge base. These are pre-existing failures, not blockers from this PR:

- UI lib: 1637 passed, 7 failed, 8 ignored. Six failures are in `egui_app::report_tests`; the seventh is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`.
- UI shell: 20 passed, 1 failed. The failure is `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`.

The UI lib errors include:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```

The shell assertion reports:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: 1
 right: 0
```

I found no issue that tracks these eight exact failures. #3879 tracks GPU skip reporting separately.

**Extra suites run**

The quick gate ran `example_catalog` (43 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed), and `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed), by name. No testdata, fixture, golden-directory or importer change triggers another extra suite.

**Safety, mutations and goldens**

This is a diagnostic change. It changes no posted G-code, gouge or collision check, stock simulation, or geometry. The shared spindle predicate preserves the old comparisons. No safety-tier mutation replay was required or run. The author's mutation results were not independently verified.

Goldens moved: none. The diff contains no recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, or catalog program change. The catalog and selected golden suites passed. Full heavy lanes were not run, under AGENTS.md “Heavy lanes at review”.

I will set `needs-rework` for the missing screenshots. The worktree and `review-3963` branch remain in place for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: none. The requested before/after screenshots remain blocked on this host.

The temporary UI harness opened the catalog and added `EM-0300-2FL` with `Tormach 770MX (ML)` mounted. The status showed the expected warning: 15000 rpm exceeds 10000 rpm.

Image rendering failed with `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`. Native capture failed with `could not create image from display`.

All temporary source changes were removed. The worktree is clean. No images, evidence files, or commits were added to the PR branch. The warm worktree remains in place.

Head unchanged: `7d4686af9528267a7f966ed1a307b27c4cb1779c`.

Quick, heavy, catalog, and clippy checks were not rerun in this round because capture failed and no fix was made. The PR body now records the missing evidence and the capture errors. The screenshot request remains open. Re-review is needed after a host with a graphics adapter supplies the images.

Addressed: the missing before/after UI screenshots.

The PR body now links both screenshots from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
Both show the catalog add of `EM-0300-2FL` with `Tormach 770MX (ML)` mounted.
The before image omits the status warning. The after image shows the 15000 rpm / 10000 rpm warning.
Image commit: `a8a13408bfcea24c4dcd205f99e1b1bf6b19a064`.

The pin `adding_a_tool_above_the_machines_speed_says_so_in_the_status` failed with the warning removed.
It passed after restoration. All temporary source changes were removed.
No images or review evidence were committed to the PR branch.

PR head is unchanged: `7d4686af9528267a7f966ed1a307b27c4cb1779c`.
The plain branch push reported `Everything up-to-date`.

Final checks against `upstream/main` at `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`:

- Quick: RED. 376 steps passed. The UI build failed with E0463 missing dependency crates. It skipped 15 UI suite steps.
- Heavy: RED. 66 steps passed. One `pocket3d_hsm` test failed its mesh assertion: actual 5232, expected 6228.
- Clippy: GREEN for all touched crates and targets.
- Catalog: 43 passed, 4 ignored. Adaptive and edge-work suites each passed.
- `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed. No goldens moved in this PR.

The body contains the commands, counts, and diagnostics. The gate failures were not checked on bare upstream/main.
Please re-review the screenshot finding. The PR remains a draft. The clean warm worktree remains in place.
